https://github.com/speps/LibTessDotNet

Original author Eric Veach; libtess2 by Mikko Mononen; C# port by Remi Gillig.
Unmodified sources, compiled in double precision. SGI Free Software License B 2.0
is included in LICENSE.txt and in every source file. Used for contour union and
hole-preserving polygon tessellation. No game data is part of this dependency.
